input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at 12 months' fees and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual and set it at twelve months' fees, and replaced the broken cross-reference with Excluded Claims so indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and wilful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.oldText: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES. COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR FOR ANY REASON ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR.
ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S MAXIMUM AGGREGATE LIABILITY TO THE OTHER ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR ANY STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, AND ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILFUL MISCONDUCT.
